sections.label: Areas of retention
sections.title: What the loss is worth, <t>in four forms.</t>
sections.lede: Drawn from the published practice and the intake checklists issued to counsel. Each tied to published research on the same question. Broader business services are the firm's.

cards.label: Life care plans
cards.title: What will future care cost?
cards.desc: Costing life care plans and reducing future care needs to present value: the stated specialty. Papers from 2024 and 2025 on how future medical care is projected, and on hospital inflation.

cta.t: Discuss a life care plan matter

cards.label: Personal injury
cards.title: What earning capacity was lost?
cards.desc: The injury checklist asks for five years of earnings records, fringe benefits and household services, before and after the injury.

cards.label: Wrongful death
cards.title: What was the economic loss to the family?
cards.desc: The death checklist covers earnings history, fringe benefits and household services. A 2024 paper addresses which database to use for life expectancy.

cards.label: Household services
cards.title: What is unpaid care worth?
cards.desc: The economic value of household services, care and support, including nighttime protection: the subject of a 2019 paper in The Earnings Analyst.

sections.fn: Areas stated by subject matter. No case outcome, client or result is claimed on this site.

sections.label: How to read this record
sections.title: Every claim carries <t>its source.</t>
sections.lede: An attorney retaining an expert needs to know what the expert states, what documents show, and what others have recorded. This site keeps the three apart, and says so beside every figure.

items.d: Stated on bpettingill.com or in the curriculum vitae dated 7 July 2025. Shown as stated. Degrees, appointments and memberships are not checked against university or association records.
A dated document published on bpettingill.com, such as the testimony listing. Linked, with its date. Deposition pages dated 20 February 2026; trial pages 26 August 2025.
A record kept outside the two Pettingill websites: a publisher, PubMed, Crossref or Zenodo. Linked to the source.
A figure counted by Ignite Yourself from a public document, with the method stated beside it.

sections.label: Starting an engagement
sections.title: What a paralegal needs, <t>in one place.</t>
sections.intro: Public documents, gathered and dated, so the current version is never in doubt.

rows.d: Eight pages: education, appointments, organizations and publications. Current PDF dated 7 July 2025. [Open the CV](https://www.bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Bernard.Pettingill.Ph_.D.Vita_.pdf)
Depositions and trials since 2017, with case, number and court. [See the count](/pettingill/testimony)

Separate checklists for personal injury and for death, completed by counsel and returned with a report due date. [Injury checklist](https://bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Injury-Checklist.pdf) · [Death checklist](https://bpettingill.com/wp-content/uploads/Death-Checklist.pdf)
Billing rates, retainer and cancellation terms, with an engagement letter to download. Confirm current terms directly. [Published terms](https://bpettingill.com/new-case/billing-rates/)
